scope: Read-only production log comparison; different scenes, not a controlled paired performance benchmark. No training algorithm/config changes.
phase_caveat: Host spans include CUDA launch/wait/synchronization. Per-phase rank maxima need not come from the same rank, overlap or nest, and must not be summed as a kernel profile.

mechanisms.shared_condition: Frozen condition cache removes a small number of per-scene encoder executions; action network is still evaluated for every candidate and transition.
mechanisms.activation_checkpointing: Each grad-enabled velocity call uses non-reentrant checkpoint; backward recomputes the action call.
mechanisms.precision: BF16 parameter storage; CUDA FP32 autocast in velocity, action history/projector profile; FP32 accumulation/communication/master/moments; TF32 disabled. BF16 storage is not evidence that action compute uses BF16.
mechanisms.historical_chunk1_2: FAIL unchanged; batching is not enabled based on these timing observations.

documentation_correction: README formerly generalized forward activations as BF16. Actual dtype evidence and numerical profile already recorded action FP32. README corrected without modifying original evidence, active training configuration or the model.
